{{Quote|Before the outbreak of war, the twilight of the Republic was an era of distractions, with citizens from all walks of life following escapist pursuits. Historians rebuke the people of this last age for being taken in by such circuses when their attentions should have been focused on the malfeasances and corruption in the Senate and other governing institutions.|Janyor|<ref name="SWP" />}}
The '''Republic Era''', also known as the '''era of the Republic''', the '''Age of Republic''', the '''Old Republic Era''', or the '''Great Peace''', was a period in [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]] marked by the rise and fall of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Following the [[fall of the Old Republic]], the Republic Era commenced with the establishment of the modern [[Galaxy|Galactic]] Republic. Aided by the [[Jedi Knight|Knights]] of the [[Jedi Order]], the [[Galactic Senate]] of the Republic governed [[the galaxy]] in a [[time]] of peace that lasted for roughly a [[millennium]]. The height of Republic power came with a portion of its reign known as the [[High Republic Era]].

The Republic gradually declined under a stagnant [[Bureaucrat|bureaucracy]] and [[Politics|political]] corruption, and its final [[Standard year|years]] were remembered as the '''Twilight of the Republic''' or the '''Twilight of the Old Republic'''. The [[Invasion of Naboo]], followed by the [[Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Clone Wars]], marked the Republic's transition from a [[democracy]] to a [[Republic Military|military]] [[dictatorship]] under [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. This thirteen-year period from [[32 BBY]] to [[19 BBY]] became known as the '''fall of the Republic''' or the '''fall of the Jedi''' . In the aftermath of the implementation of [[Order 66]], which saw the [[Mission to Mustafar|collapse]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Jedi]]'s [[Great Jedi Purge|annihilation]], Palpatine—the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Sidious—[[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaimed]] [[Gender|himself]] [[Galactic Emperor]], transforming the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]]. The Republic Era concluded with the dawn of the [[Imperial Era]].

[[Historian]]s regarded the Republic Era as the "last era of peace." After it ended, the Empire ruled the galaxy under the [[New Order]]'s [[Fascism|fascist]] ideology, leading to the [[Galactic Civil War]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which became known as the Age of Rebellion. The [[New Republic]] sought to restore peace and democracy to the galaxy; however, the [[New Republic Era]]'s last years were marked by a [[Cold War]] with the [[First Order]], a successor state of the Old Empire, and ended with the New Republic's [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]]. As a result, [[First Order-Resistance War|open war]] broke out between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], until a pan-galactic [[uprising against the First Order]] took place.

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|There hasn't been a full-scale war since the formation of the Republic.|Sio Bibble|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
{{Main|Old Republic-era|Fall of the Old Republic}}
[[File:Great_Scourge_of_Malachor_aftermath.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic Era was preceded by a dark age of war between Jedi and Sith.]]
Roughly a [[Millennium|thousand]] [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Jedi]] and the [[Sith]] were at [[Jedi-Sith War|war]] with each other. The Sith were [[Defeat of the Sith|eventually defeated]] when their greed for power caused them to turn on each other, which allowed the Jedi to defeat the weakened Sith, leaving them all but destroyed.<ref name="Sith-SWE">{{SWE|groups|sith|Sith}}</ref> However, one [[Sith Lord]] emerged as the sole survivor: [[Darth Bane]]. Realizing that the Sith's greed led to their demise, Bane decided that the Sith needed to operate in secret to get revenge, favoring guile and conspiracy rather than brute force.<ref name="Bane-DB">{{Databank|darth-bane|Darth Bane}}</ref> With that, he formed the [[Rule of Two]], which mandated that only two Sith Lords could exist at any given [[time]]: a [[Sith Master|master]] to represent the power of the [[dark side of the Force]], and an [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] to [[Sith training|train]] under the master and one day fulfill their role. [[Darth]] Bane took on an apprentice of his own,<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref> [[Darth Zannah]], who was rumored to have [[Death|killed]] Bane on [[Ambria]] in a [[lightsaber duel]];<ref name="HC 2">{{HelmetCollectionCite|2|Databank A-Z}}</ref> nonetheless, Bane's apprentice continued his tradition<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and moved forward with the [[Grand Plan]].<ref name="Bane Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|darth-bane|Darth Bane}}</ref>

===The Great Peace===
{{SeeAlso|High Republic Era}}
{{Quote|The Galactic Republic was the Republic of legend, greater than distance or time.|Janyor|<ref name="SWP" />}}
[[File:Galactic_Senate.png|thumb|right|250px|The Galactic Republic presided over an age of peace for roughly a thousand years.]]
During this time, the [[Galactic Republic]] was reformed,<ref name="SWP" /> and the [[Jedi Order]] enjoyed [[Politics|political]] ascension,<ref name="Episode I" /> rebuilding the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[capital]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Coruscant]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> to [[Jedi training|train]] [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] in the way of [[the Force]].<ref name="Rise" /> The [[High Republic Era]] was a particular part of the Republic's reign where the government was at the height of its power.<ref name="Reveal">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-high-republic|text=Lucasfilm to Launch ''Star Wars: The High Republic'' Publishing Campaign in 2021}}</ref>

The Republic Era,<ref name="V9">[[Darth Vader (2015) 9|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 9]]</ref> also known as the "era of the Republic,"<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> the "Age of Republic,"<ref name="Republic">''[[Star Wars: Age of Republic]]''</ref> or the "Great Peace," was characterized by the lack of [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-spanning wars, although some smaller [[sector]] and [[Star system|system]] conflicts, such as the [[Stark Hyperspace War]] or the [[Great Clan Wars|Mandalorian Civil War]], consumed the time and energy of the Republic and the Jedi.<ref name="Rise" /> Nevertheless, it was remembered by [[Janyor]] and other [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Era|period]] [[historian]]s as the last era of peace in [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]].<ref name="SWP" /> Even the High Republic Era, however, was not immune to conflict as the peace and prosperity of the time was rivaled by the decisions of certain actors, most notably the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]].<ref name="CompleteNew">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> The [[Nihil conflict]] between the Republic and Nihil, despite ending with the defeat of the Nihil, opened the idea of secession from the Republic government.<ref name="Trials of the Jedi">''[[The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi]]''</ref>

===Fall of the Republic===
{{Quote|Too late? For what, the Republic to fall? It already has and you just can't see it, there is no justice, no law, no order except for the one that will replace it.|[[Maul]]|<ref name="The Phantom Apprentice">{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}}</ref>}}
The "Twilight of the Republic,"<ref name="SWP" /> also known as the "Twilight of the Old Republic,"<ref name="SW 26">[[Star Wars (2015) 26|''Star Wars'' (2015) 26]]</ref> referred to the Republic Era in its final years.<ref name="SWP" /> Long after Bane's rule was introduced, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis]] took on an apprentice, [[Darth Sidious]], the Sith persona of [[Senator]] Sheev Palpatine of [[Naboo]]. Sidious eventually [[Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise|killed]] his master in his sleep when he had no use for him anymore.<ref name="Episode III" /><ref name="BioGal1">{{Databank|darth-sidious-biography-gallery|Darth Sidious Biography Gallery}} {{C|Image 1 caption}}</ref> With the "High" Republic Era behind it,<ref name="Reveal" /> the Republic entered a protracted decline as the "old ways" of thinking began to fail<ref name="FearofMask">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref> and corruption took root across the government, particularly in the Senate, where self-interested senators and the presence of corporate actors, such as companies and trade guilds, spread the influence of greed.<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>

One event that took place in this time was the [[Coronation of Queen Amidala|election]] of [[Padmé Amidala]] as [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] of Naboo.<ref name="SWP" />

[[File:Senator_palpatine.png|thumb|left|250px|Sheev Palpatine was a facade for Darth Sidious, who sought to rule the galaxy by ending democracy.]]
The "fall of the Republic"<ref name="Cham DB">{{Databank|cham-syndulla|Cham Syndulla}}</ref> began with Sidious instigating several conflicts in [[the galaxy]] in order to gain power, beginning with the [[Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation]].<ref name="Kenobi Databank">{{Databank|obi-wan-kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi}}</ref><ref name="Maul Databank">{{Databank|darth-maul|Darth Maul}}</ref> He used this incident to cause then [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] to be [[Vote of No Confidence|voted out]] of [[Office of the Chancellor|office]], manipulating [[Queen]] Amidala into calling for the vote over her anger at the [[Galactic Senate]]'s inaction over the invasion; Valorum was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY|replaced]] by Senator Palpatine himself.<ref name="Episode I" /> Further governmental inaction and corruption ultimately led to the [[Separatist Crisis]], in which thousands of worlds seceded from the Republic and formed a separate government, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Tensions fostered between the two factions through the machinations of Sidious and his [[Sith apprentice]], [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]], who led the Separatists through his public identity as [[Count of Serenno|Count]] Dooku, ultimately led to the outbreak of the pan-[[Galaxy|galactic]] [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="Episode II" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Geonosis.png|thumb|right|250px|The Battle of Geonosis marked the end of the Great Peace and the start of the Clone Wars.]]
The [[First Battle of Geonosis|First Battle of]] [[Geonosis]] marked the end of the Great Peace and the beginning of the Clone Wars; having mobilized a [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] to serve as its [[Republic Military|new military]], the Republic went to war against the Separatists, led by the former Jedi-turned-Sith Lord Count Dooku. The Sith had not completely [[Death|died]] out at the end of their war with the Jedi, and had been plotting for [[Standard century|centuries]] to overthrow the Jedi and the Republic.<ref name="Rise" />

The Clone Wars raged for three years,<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> during which the Republic became an increasingly militarized state in the name of order and security against the Separatist threat. Chancellor Palpatine, whose term was already extended due to the Separatist Crisis, remained in office for the duration of the conflict, all the while centralizing political and military authority in the Office of the Chancellor through the various wartime emergency powers granted to him by the [[Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Episode II" /><ref name="Episode III" /> [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]] of the neutral planet [[Mandalore]] observed the changes in the Republic and warned her former lover [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the changing tide.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> After he and Dooku manipulated [[Rush Clovis]] and orchestrated the [[Invasion of Scipio|Separatist takeover]] of [[Scipio]], another power given to Chancellor Palpatine was control of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="CH">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>

[[File:Declaration.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic Era was over when Darth Sidious declared himself Emperor of the First Galactic Empire.]]
In the waning [[Standard day|days]] of the Clone Wars<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> the Separatists suffered a series of major defeats, including the [[death]]s of Dooku and [[General]] [[Grievous]] at the hands of [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], respectively. Meanwhile, the [[Jedi High Council]], who became increasingly wary of Palpatine due to his unprecedented wartime powers, discovered his identity as the enigmatic Sith Lord Darth Sidious. The Jedi's [[Duel in Palpatine's office|attempt]] to apprehend him ultimately failed and fostered Skywalker's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] and rechristening as Sidious' new apprentice, Darth Vader. Vader was subsequently sent to lead [[Operation: Knightfall]]. Simultaneously, Palpatine instituted [[Order 66]] to the Republic Army, beginning the initial part of the [[Great Jedi Purge|systematic destruction]] of the Jedi Order, as [[clone trooper]]s executed their [[Jedi General]]s across the [[galaxy]].<ref name="Episode III" />

With the Jedi Order decimated, Palpatine gave the [[proclamation of the New Order]] to an [[Special session of Congress|emergency session]] of the Galactic Senate, where he declared the Jedi enemies of the state, while transforming the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]], with himself as [[Galactic Emperor]]. At the same time, Vader [[Mission to Mustafar|destroyed]] the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] and deactivated the [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]], effectively ending the Clone Wars and cementing the return of the galaxy to the rule of the Sith.<ref name="Episode III" />

The subsequent years were called the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]].<ref name="A New Dawn" />
